planted.status_code: 订单.状态码 0=已交付, 1=未交付(生产中/待发货等), 2=取消(if any); text status removed
planted.fan_out: 订单 1:N 售后工单 (45 tickets); joining then summing 订单.金额 double-counts
planted.snapshot: 库存快照 is month x product; summing 库存数量 across months is wrong
planted.versions: 订单承诺 has 1-3 versions per order for first 60 orders; counting rows != orders
planted.p50: 交付统计.交付天数P50 is the mean, not the median
